decision.reason: In every bootstrap, the median serial replay-work growth between completed depths exceeds the zero-overhead batch span estimate.

limitations: instrumented observer changes runtime costs; sequential local five-process diagnostics are not native isolation
fixed-depth probes warm V8/OS state, preserve checkpoint re-sync/fsync, and create no new logical stage; they are outside the read lease, not graph read successes
exclusive phase sums partition each readCommitted only; do not add nested RPC or owner wall times to end-to-end latency
mac/hash phases include setup, update and digest; schema checks and other glue remain in journal/stage residual
partial and refused reads stay separate; no failure-prefix reduction ratio
no independent SGA, actual batch run or paged five-owner production adoption
fixed-depth probes always use the history selector, while provider, issuer and broker reads use the receipt selector
scope: three independent local five-process bootstraps; instrumented v1 full path plus read-only fixed-depth probes; no actual batching or speed approval
